title: Wire or remove the no-op profileMode parameter on reward_config_controller_test.dart's _makeContainer
rule: TQ-7-adjacent (test helper must do what its doc comment claims)

evidence.quote: /// Pass [profileMode] as 'child' or 'adult' to test profile-type branching.

why: _makeContainer's doc comment promises profileMode drives 'profile-type branching' overrides, but the function body only ever reads profileId — profileMode is accepted and silently discarded. The one call site that passes profileMode: 'adult' (in the 'product rule: adults have no points' test) gets zero behavioral effect from it; a future test adding profileMode: 'child' expecting a different container wiring would get a false pass.
recommendation: Either delete the unused parameter, or wire it to an actual profile-mode override (e.g. a stubbed profileModeProvider) so it matches its doc comment.
acceptance_criteria: _makeContainer's profileMode parameter is either removed or demonstrably changes container behavior, with a test asserting the difference between 'adult' and 'child'.
